title: Icons / button and travel figures
slide_intent: Give symbols specific information jobs so they help readers recognize actions and quantities.
strategic_value: A shared icon style can connect DB interface controls and performance information.
demonstration: A red button with globe and arrow appears beside travel statistics using train and people icons.
practical_value: Compare an action label with an icon-supported information panel.

content_islands.name: Button
content_islands.spec: Center the red action button on the dark panel at left.

content_islands.name: Information graphic
content_islands.spec: Pair transport icons with percentages and a people icon with a traveler-growth figure at right.

reference_purposes.Application: Icons are used in a button and in a travel-information graphic.
